ACTION=A1
Rationale: A motorcycle is cutting into the ego vehicle's lane from the right at $y=3.5$ moving toward $y=0.0$, starting at $x=23.0\text{ m}$ with a velocity of $9.0\text{ m/s}$. To maintain safe following distance and accommodate the sudden cut-in, the ego vehicle should gently decelerate (A1: decelerate / slow down).
